summary: Fixed errors on provider dashboard. Removed pages_alljobs.js dependency which was causing jsPDF error. Created standalone booking data array in provider_dashboard.php for pending jobs display. This eliminates jsPDF dependency error and bookingData undefined error. Services now load properly using myservices from script.js. Pending jobs display correctly with clickable cards that navigate to alljobs.php detail page.
current_status: All errors fixed. Provider dashboard now shows both pending jobs and services correctly without any JavaScript errors. Ready for testing.
